context.problem: Decide whether to retain Clojure or rewrite Gleanmo in another language.
constraints: Hold the target database and required user behavior constant when comparing language options.
Use current observations for agent performance. Historical rankings are context, not assessments.
Framework and runtime details remain open until the user specifies them.

completion_guidance.blank_values: Null weights and scores are unassessed, not zero. Empty notes and conclusions await user input.
completion_guidance.weights: Set each weight to low, medium, or high when ready.
completion_guidance.scores: Use 0 through 5, with higher scores always indicating a better fit. For effort, cost, risk, and churn, lower burden scores higher.
completion_guidance.comparison: Assess migration costs separately from ongoing benefits. Record concrete stack and hosting assumptions in option notes before scoring.
completion_guidance.ownership: The user will provide assessments. No option has been ranked or selected.

options.label: Clojure — retain and evolve
options.description: Continue the current application, allowing the database and framework decisions to change independently.

options.label: Go — rewrite
options.description: Rewrite the application in Go. Specify framework and data-access choices before assessment.

options.label: TypeScript — rewrite
options.description: Rewrite the application in TypeScript. Specify runtime, framework, and data-access choices before assessment.

options.label: Rust — rewrite
options.description: Rewrite the application in Rust. Specify framework and data-access choices before assessment.

criteria.label: Personal enjoyment
criteria.description: Enjoyment of reading, changing, and maintaining the application.

criteria.label: Code readability
criteria.description: Ease of understanding implementation details and reviewing changes.

criteria.label: Agent implementation quality
criteria.description: Observed correctness and maintainability of agent-generated changes.

criteria.label: Agent verification autonomy
criteria.description: Ability of agents to verify and correct changes without user intervention.

criteria.label: Compiler feedback
criteria.description: Usefulness and speed of static feedback before running the application.

criteria.label: Development speed
criteria.description: Time needed to implement verified changes after the transition.

criteria.label: Debugging effort
criteria.description: Work required to locate and fix defects.

criteria.label: Deployment simplicity
criteria.description: Burden of building, packaging, deploying, and operating the application.

criteria.label: Ecosystem longevity
criteria.description: Expected durability of the language, libraries, tooling, and available expertise.

criteria.label: Rewrite effort
criteria.description: Work required to reach a usable replacement, including integration and verification.

criteria.label: Feature parity risk
criteria.description: Risk of losing existing behavior, workflows, or data semantics during replacement.

criteria.label: Opportunity cost
criteria.description: Value of features and other projects deferred while transitioning.
